info.name: Baked Bouquet API
info.description:
Backend API for the Baked Bouquet multi-branch/franchise ordering platform. Run requests top-to-bottom within a folder — each one captures IDs/tokens into environment variables that later requests reuse. Use the 'Baked Bouquet — Local' environment.

Dev note: local email is logged to the API process console, not actually sent (no Postmark token configured). Copy the `otp` value from the server log into the environment's `otp` variable before running Verify OTP / Verify Reset OTP.

exec: console.log('Check the API server console log for the OTP sent to', pm.environment.get('customerEmail'));

item.name: Staff Login (Super Admin)
item.description: Run `go run ./cmd/seed` once against a fresh database to create this super admin account (admin@bakedbouquet.com / ChangeMe123!).

item.name: List Staff (Network Directory)

exec: pm.test('roles array present per staff member', () => {

item.description: SA-16 network-wide staff directory. Scoped: brand roles (super admin, finance) see everyone; franchise/branch-scoped roles only see staff sharing their scope.

item.name: Invite Staff — Branch Manager
item.description: branchId is a placeholder UUID until the tenancy module (franchises/branches) ships — the FK constraint is added then, so any UUID works today.

item.name: Invite Staff — Kitchen Role (permission denied example)
Create Franchise
item.description: Requires super_admin (franchise.manage).

item.name: Create Branch — Edison NJ
item.description: Requires super_admin or franchise_owner. Run 'Create Franchise' first so {{franchiseId}} is set. New branches go straight to status=active (GOV-05/NFR-14).

item.name: Create Branch — Trappe PA (zone overlap example)
item.description: Shares ZIP 08837 with Edison NJ on purpose — demonstrates the GOV-08 overlap warning (non-blocking).

item.name: Update Branch — Operational Field (name)
item.description: Allowed for branch_manager and above (PermBranchOperational).

item.name: Update Branch — Commercial Field (delivery fee)
item.description: Requires super_admin or franchise_owner (PermBranchCommercial). Run with {{staffAccessToken}} = a branch_manager token to see GOVERNANCE_VIOLATION (403).

item.name: Check Delivery — Eligible ZIP
item.description: Matches the Edison NJ zip_list zone created above — run after 'Create Branch — Edison NJ'.

item.name: Check Delivery — Unserved ZIP (nearest-branches fallback)
item.description: No branch covers this ZIP — eligible:false with up to 3 nearest branches and emailCapturePrompt:true (SF-03). Distance is null unless GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is configured.

item.name: List Products (Edison NJ branch)
item.description: CAT-07: unavailable items are still returned, with availability.available=false and a reason — never silently omitted. Run 'Tenancy — Branches > Create Branch — Edison NJ' first so {{branchId}} is set.

item.name: Get Product Detail — Berry Blossom Cupcake Bouquet
item.description: Matches the approved Figma product-detail screen exactly: 6/9/12/15-count variants at $68/$88/$109/$129, Flavours, Add a little extra, Presentation, Wrap Colour modifier groups.

item.name: Create Product (Test Product)
item.description: Requires super_admin (catalogue.edit_master — brand-locked, GOV-02).

item.name: Update Product — Partial (price band only)

body.raw:
{
  "categoryId": "11111111-0000-0000-0000-000000000002",
  "name": "Test Cupcake Box",
  "slug": "{{newProductSlug}}",
  "description": "A product created via Postman for testing.",
  "basePriceCents": 4500,
  "priceFloorCents": 4000,
  "priceCeilingCents": 5500
}

item.description: Omits "variants"/"modifierGroups" on purpose — these must be left untouched, not wiped (see the store-layer nil-guard). Follow with 'Get Product (Admin)' to confirm the variant created above still exists.

item.name: Update Availability — Price Override Below Floor (rejected)
item.description: Expects 422 PRICE_BELOW_FLOOR once a price floor has been set on the product (GOV-10). Run 'Get Product Detail' first so {{productId}} is set.

item.name: Update Availability — Disable at this Branch
Sold Out (one-tap)
item.description: ADM-14: one-tap sold-out, no navigation into settings. Creates a date override for today only.

item.name: Get Available Slots (pickup)
item.description: SF-20/SCH-01..06: only slots the branch can genuinely fulfil, with remaining capacity, are ever returned. Run 'Ordering — Admin > Update Schedule Config' or set opening hours on the branch first if this comes back empty.

item.name: Add to Cart — Berry Blossom (guest)
item.description: No Authorization header — guest checkout (SF-29). The response's X-Cart-Token header identifies this cart on every subsequent call; captured into {{guestCartToken}} and sent via the X-Cart-Token header on the requests below. Run 'Catalog — Storefront > Get Product Detail' first so {{productId}}/{{variantId}}/{{flavourId}} are set.

item.name: Set Schedule
item.description: Use a date/slotStart returned by 'Get Available Slots' above — slot times come back as HH:MM:SS.

item.name: Create Order (checkout)
item.description: Payment is captured via NoopPaymentProcessor until the payments module ships — no real charge occurs. Re-sending this exact request (same Idempotency-Key) returns the SAME order rather than creating a duplicate (SF-28) — even after this first call clears the cart.

item.name: Track Order (public, no auth)
item.description: SF-32: safe to share with the recipient — no login required, minimal info (e.g. recipient shown as "John K.").

item.name: Cancel My Order
item.description: ORD-16 tiered refund: full refund if well ahead of the slot, 50% if within the branch's lead-time window.

item.name: Reorder
item.description: ACC-12: re-validates availability/pricing rather than blindly replaying — unavailable items come back as warnings instead of failing the whole reorder.

item.name: Claim Guest Order
item.description: ACC-14: links a guest order to this account once the purchaser email matches.

item.name: List Orders — Search by Recipient/Phone
item.description: ADM-01: a manager on the phone finds an order by recipient name/phone in under 10 seconds.

item.name: Amend Order — Gift Message
item.description: ORD-06..15: every amendment is audited with before/after values. Only works while the order is pre-production (placed/confirmed/scheduled).

item.name: Amend Order — Reschedule
item.description: ORD-09: releases the original slot and reserves the new one atomically.

item.name: Mark Fulfilled
item.description: ADM-05: the manual close path used in R1 while POS/KDS routing is not yet live.

item.name: Create Manual Order (telephone — ADM-10)
item.description: Goes through the exact same cart -> checkout pipeline as the storefront, just built from staff input — same validation and slot-reservation guarantees, auto-confirmed on creation.

item.name: Update Schedule Config
item.description: SCH-01, SCH-02, SCH-05. A newly created branch already has sensible defaults (60 min slots, 10 orders/slot, 2h lead time) — this endpoint is for tuning them, not a required setup step.

item.name: Uplift Slot Capacity (peak day)
item.description: SCH-09: temporary capacity increase for a known busy date (Valentine's, Mother's Day) without changing the standing schedule config. Get {{slotId}} from 'List Slots for a Date'.

item.name: Branch Dashboard
item.description: ADM-20: today's revenue/orders/AOV, order status breakdown, upcoming 7-day slot capacity load.

item.name: Branch Sales By Day — CSV Export
item.description: REP-16 CSV export — pass format=csv on any report list endpoint.

item.name: Branch Best/Worst Sellers
item.description: ADM-21. Same list sorted by revenue descending; bestSellers is the head, worstSellers the tail.

item.name: Branch Fulfilment Performance
item.description: Avg prep minutes and on-time completion rate, derived from order_status_events.

item.name: Branch Amendment Log
item.description: ADM-21 amendment log — paginated, newest first.

item.name: Comparable ("Like-for-Like") Sales
item.description: REP-06 to REP-09, BRD Section 11.3. Only branches active and trading in BOTH periods, and open at least maturityMonths before compareFrom, count as comparable; every excluded branch is listed in nonComparable with a reason (new, suspended, closed, no_orders_in_period). Requires reports.comparable (super_admin, finance).

item.name: Comparable Sales — Low Maturity Threshold (see newly-opened branches become comparable)
item.description: maturityMonths=0 (or omitted) falls back to the BRD default of 13 — this request demonstrates that default, not a literal zero-month threshold.

item.description: SA-15. Requires a brand-scoped role (super_admin, finance) — every other role gets 403.

item.name: List Customers
item.description: ADM-19. Brand-scoped roles see every customer; franchise/branch-scoped roles only see customers who have ordered from their scope.

item.description: Includes totalOrders/totalSpendCents/lastOrderAt and tags.

item.name: Create Checkout Session (hosted Payment Link)
item.description: Opens a Stripe Checkout page and returns its `id` (save as {{checkoutSessionId}}) and `url`. Redirect the browser to `url`; Stripe sends it back to STOREFRONT_BASE_URL + returnPath with `?session_id=...` appended.

item.name: Get Checkout Session
item.description: Reads a hosted-checkout session back live from Stripe. Once `paymentStatus` is `paid`, take `paymentId` from the response and send it as `payment.paymentId` on `POST /storefront/orders`.
